PDF GPU-Based Cell Projection for Interactive Volume Rendering
We have presented a Cell Projection Volume Rendering method that takes full advantage of modern graphics hard-ware. The implementation 1 achieves rates over 2.0 M Tet/s with high quality images, and, at the same time offers inter-active control over the transfer function.
